name: Brian J. Levy & Associates, P.C.
about: Brian J. Levy & Associates gives Westchester Avenue in the Bronx as the firm's address in its own structured data, and keeps a second office in Syosset, out on Long Island. Its attorneys page names one person, Brian J. Levy.

906 reviews at 5.0 in the Bronx and 1,770 at the Syosset office, which is the larger listing by a wide margin and sits outside this market. A free consultation, a 24 hour line and pages in Spanish, published. Its site has the fastest largest contentful paint of the new entries and still fails Core Web Vitals, on total blocking time.
